question: My page uses custom2, which inherits custom1, which inherits archive. Will it still be h-feed? Do I need a YAML flag in my page?
expected: In v2.1.1-dev (main, not released v2.1.0) custom layouts inheriting archive, indexcategory, cloudtag or cloudcategory retain h-feed through multiple layout layers. No additional page YAML setting or configuration option is needed; the built-in list layouts propagate the internal feed metadata automatically.

result.answer:
Yes, your page will still use `h-feed`. Because `custom2` inherits `custom1`, which in turn inherits `archive`, the `h-feed` microformat is retained through the inheritance chain. You do not need to add any YAML flag or layout change to your page to maintain this behavior.

Please note that this behavior is part of unreleased development refactoring following v2.1.0.

[Layout structure and components](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts#layout-structure-and-components)
